channel.description: Latest articles from Official EVO Magazine (evo.co.uk)

item.title: Ford Mustang Dark Horse SC is Detroit's answer to the Porsche 911 GT3
item.description: A supercharged heart transplant and numerous choice upgrades should make for the most thrilling Mustang under the £315,000 GTD

item.title: The Chevrolet Corvette ZR1X is quicker than a Bugatti Tourbillon – with one caveat
item.description: The 1250bhp Corvette ZR1X has already shown its worth at the Nürburgring, and now it’s posted a hypercar-matching quarter-mile time

item.title: Ford’s Hypercar will use a roaring V8 to take on Ferrari once again
item.description: A 5.4-litre V8 derived from the heart of the Mustang will power Ford’s hopes of taking to the top step

item.title: Ford’s F1 comeback: marketing fluff or a genuine partnership?
item.description: Ford’s F1 comeback has got the cynics raising eyebrows. We went to Detroit to decipher the Blue Oval’s true role in Red Bull’s in-house F1 powertrain

item.title: Aston Martin’s F1 safety car is dead: Mercedes takes the reins for 2026
item.description: After a five-year stint, Aston Martin is handing the reins to Mercedes-AMG for Formula 1 safety and medical car duties

item.title: Rejoice! A restomod that isn't based on a 911. Meet the Encor Series 1
item.description: British firm Encor has revealed the S1, a carbonfibre bodied, 400bhp twin-turbo V8 homage to the original S1 Lotus Esprit. Yours for at least £500,000.

item.title: New Volvo EX60 is a BMW iX3 rival with more power than a Ferrari Enzo
item.description: Volvo’s coming out swinging against BMW with the new EX60, bringing big power and range to the fight

item.title: New AI-powered website helps you find the best driving roads
item.description: ‘New Roads’ website is a new way to plan your road trips and incorporate the best possible driving roads

item.title: Bugatti F.K.P. Hommage: 20 years later, Bugatti facelifts the Veyron
item.description: One-of-one special Bugatti Solitaire customer car reimagines the Veyron for the 2020s, and gives it 60 per cent more power

item.title: Bentley’s electric SUV still coming in spite of industry trends – new 2027 model spied
item.description: Crewe’s ‘urban SUV’ is shedding disguise during winter testing ahead of a full reveal before the end of the year
